title: Charming Tudor-Style Cottage – 3 Bedroom Apt
description:
Enjoy a comfortable Pittsburgh stay in this three-bedroom apartment with space for up to six guests. Historic character, inviting furnishings and practical amenities make it a welcoming home base for vacations, work trips and longer stays.

The apartment offers a fully equipped kitchen, Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, a TV, air conditioning, heating, and a washer and dryer. Bed linens, towels, extra pillows and blankets are provided.

Prepare meals with the cookware and kitchen appliances, gather around the dining table, or relax after a day of exploring Pittsburgh. Free parking is available on the premises and on the street.

You have a private entrance and easy self check-in with a keypad. Pets and longer stays are welcome. Please note: stairs are required to reach the apartment.
stairs_info: Stairs are required to reach the apartment. The entrance is at the top of the stairs.
arrival_instructions: Self check-in with the keypad at the private entrance. Please leave your shoes at the entrance at the top of the stairs.
house_rules: Self check-in is available with a keypad.
Quiet hours are from 7:00 pm to 6:00 am.
This is a shoe-free apartment. Please leave your shoes at the entrance at the top of the stairs.
Please keep the apartment clean and tidy. Our cleaning team handles used bedding and general cleaning after checkout.
Checkout: place used towels in the hampers provided or on the bathroom floor.
Checkout: turn off the lights, air conditioning, fans, stove and other appliances. Leave the refrigerator on.
Checkout: don't lock the main door from the inside when you leave. The keypad lock locks by itself after 15 seconds.
